results.title: CNET: Product reviews, advice, how-tos and the latest news - CNET
results.description: Get full-length product reviews, the latest news, tech coverage, daily deals, and category deep dives from CNET experts worldwide.
results.text:
## Best

### NBA Arenas Get a Massive AT&T Network Upgrade to Boost Fan Experiences

Exclusive: Basketball venues are facing increasing broadcaster and fan demands, so the NBA, WNBA and AT&T are upgrading arenas with all-new communications equipment.

### Tell Us Which Security Software Is Actually Worth Your Money

Help us crown the most trusted anti virus, VPNs and security tools of 2026 in our People's Picks survey.

### This Glass Air Fryer-Slow Cooker Combo Is the Best Kitchen Tool I’ve Tested All Year

Magnifique's new cooker combines two of my favorite kitchen appliances in one nontoxic, easy-to-use machine.

### The Best Light Therapy Lamps to Prepare for the Winter Blues

If you have seasonal affective disorder, a SAD lamp or light therapy lamp can help you prepare yourself for shorter, darker days.

### The Dark Web Is Hiding in Plain Sight. That’s a Problem for All of Us

I needed to know more about the place where personal info goes to be misused and what we can do about it.

## TODAY'S DEALS

## More to Explore

## LATEST

## Our Expertise

For more than 25 years, CNET has built a reputation as the premier source for trustworthy, no-nonsense reviews on everything tech – from phones to TVs to laptops to tablets to streaming services. If you can snap a picture with it, watch it, type on it or subscribe to it, chances are we’ve reviewed it.

### David Katzmaier

Editor in Chief

### Lindsey Turrentine

EVP, Content and Audience

### Joshua Goldman

Managing Editor

### Katie Collins

Editorial Director

### Joe Supan

Senior Writer

### Abrar Al-Heeti

Senior Technology Reporter

### Voicemod’s New Phone Gadget Changes Your ‘Sonic Identity’ for Mobile Games and Streaming

Clip it to the back of your phone, and it'll convert your voice on the fly for fun, privacy and accessibility.

### The $2,000 Duo: Who Is Apple’s First Folding iPhone Actually For?

Whether you’re a fashionista, a power user or a tech nerd, the Duo is a pretty specific device with a high starting price.

### Android Strengthens Scam Defenses for Calls and Texts

Changes for tools including Google Messages, screen sharing and call forwarding are all aimed at countering mobile fraud.

### Your Phone Can Last Years Longer (and Save You a Fortune) if You Do This

Phones are expensive. Here's how to get the most value from your iPhone or Android phone.

### Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) Review: Affordability Is a Concern, but I Dig the Upgraded Sound

They're pricey at $299 — perhaps too pricey — but the Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) are the best-sounding open clip-on earbuds out there.

## HARDWARE

### Apple HomePod Mini 2: Hands-On Impressions, Siri AI and More

We saw and heard Apple's new HomePod mini today. Here's what you should know.

### HomeView and More: Everything Apple Announced at Its ‘Welcome Home’ Event

Apple is making a sweeping new entry into home tech.

### Meta’s Audio-Only Glasses Are Nicely Made. They Don’t Solve the Deeper Problems

Meta Ray-Ban Audio glasses are sleek and offer long battery life, but where will their AI go next?

### Logitech Zone Vibe Pro Headset Review: Mixing Business With Pleasure for Less

Like the pricey Jabra Evolve3 85, the Logitech Zone Vibe Pro headset leaves off the flexible boom mic so you can use it as an everyday headphone — and it's a good one at that.

### Insta360 Luna Pro vs. Luna Ultra: Which Gimbal Camera Is Better?

What’s the better 8K gimbal camera? Depends on your needs and what you're willing to spend.

## TECH TIPS

### Apple Just Smashed My Biggest Barrier to a Smarter Home With Its HomeView Reveal

Commentary: Apple's focus on simplicity and ease of setup solves my biggest gripe with almost all smart home tech so far.

### I Spent a Week with Vitamix Nano, the Brand’s First-Ever Personal Blender

There are several features that I think could use improvement.

### The Cuisinart Concentra Is a Dream Come True for Cold Brew Drinkers

I tested Cuisinart's new $100 cold coffee brewer.

### Expectation vs. Reality: We Tried a Smart Doggy Doorbell for Potty Training

How smart doggy doorbells work and what we've learned training our puppy to use one.

### After Weeks of Testing, This Is My Favorite Personal Blender

Ninja’s newest personal blender, the BlendBoss, pairs with a to-go tumbler ideal for traveling and compatible with most cupholders.

### FBI Arrests OpenAI Employee Suspected of Planting a Surveillance Bug

Espionage in AI labs poses a national security threat, according to US intelligence and security officials.

### Google’s Demis Hassabis Puts a Hopeful Spin on AI’s Environmental Impact

The DeepMind co-founder addressed AI's role in scientific inquiries and the positive outcomes he expects in addressing climate change.

### Can Vibe Coded Apps Replace Adobe and Microsoft? These AI Apps Hope So

The AI-made apps highlight people’s frustration with AI-bloated programs and increasingly expensive subscriptions.

### The Midterms Are Just Weeks Away: How to Spot Election Deepfakes and Scams

Spoiler: They’re already running rampant across the US.

### I Let Meta Muse Do My Shopping. The AI Agent Tried to Upcharge Me

I asked Meta's new AI assistant to be my personal shopper. Serious payment issues ensued.

### EVs Are the Future, No Matter How Far America Falls Behind

EV adoption is spreading at a record pace globally, yet US adoption of electric vehicles has stalled. How did we get here, and what does this mean for Americans?

## DEEP DIVES

## INTERNET

### Cricket Wireless Adds 5G Home Internet Service

Cricket joins the club of mobile providers bundling home internet with mobile phone service.

### Cox Customers Officially Make the Jump to Spectrum

Cox customers won't see anything about their internet plans change — just the name on the bill.

### You’re Probably Overpaying for Internet. Here’s How to Spot Hidden Fees

Here’s the real reason your internet bill is so high — and what you can (and can’t) do about it.

### People’s Picks ISP Winners: Is Your Internet Service Provider a Flop or Favorite?

There are several connection types, including 5G, cable, satellite and fiber. Which one is really the golden standard? CNET readers have a say.

### Trump’s FCC Just Scrapped Its Most Ambitious Broadband Goal

The new Federal Communications Commission report signals a major retreat from the former administration's goal of connecting every American to gigabit-speed broadband.
